aqProduct.descriptionHtml:
One fine line, in four colours. A fine tennis bracelet of small round brilliant cut cubic zirconia of about 3mm, each stone in its own gold four claw cup and linked straight into the next, closed with a slim fold over clasp. In bright Royal Blue, soft Lavender, rose Pink or clear White. Fine enough for every day, and easy to stack two together.

STYLING TIP: Wear two colours together on one wrist: Royal Blue with White, or Pink with Lavender.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut cubic zirconia, approximately 3mm each
  • Colours: Royal Blue, Lavender, Pink or White
  • Setting: Individual gold four claw cups linked directly to one another
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

sv.title: Clarté Baguette Bracelet — Silver
sv.descriptionHtml:
Clear light, cut in straight lines. A tennis bracelet of icy clear baguette cut cubic zirconia set crosswise, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws. The line is about 6mm wide and closes with a slim silver tone fold over clasp, so it lies flat and catches the light from every side. Wear it alone with a white shirt, or beside a fine round line for evening.

STYLING TIP: Stack it with a fine round tennis bracelet so the two cuts play off each other.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm by 3mm, set crosswise
  • Width: Approximately 6mm
  • Setting: Each stone held at its corners by fine silver tone claws, edge to edge
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Bright silver tone
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
